title: Bradley Court Limited v. Tinkasimire
issues: dismissal of a frivolous, vexatious or abusive appeal under r. 2.1

stages.known_so_far: Bradley Court Limited sued Christopher Tinkasimire in the Superior Court of Justice, and he brought a counterclaim against it.
stages.next_steps: The motion judge dismissed the counterclaim under r. 2.1.

stages.known_so_far: Bradley Court Limited sued Christopher Tinkasimire in the Superior Court of Justice, and he brought a counterclaim against it. Justice Centa dismissed the counterclaim under r. 2.1 as rambling and disclosing no cause of action.
stages.next_steps: Mr. Tinkasimire appealed; the registrar gave notice that dismissal under r. 2.1 was being considered.
